author: sourcing research (Etsy masterpiece scan)
request: Owner, 2026-10-12: 'Search etsy' (after studio rule E.14: a 'wow' masterpiece in every room and style, as a price anchor).

method.tools: WebSearch only (mostly restricted to etsy.com). One WebFetch of an Etsy listing returned HTTP 403; per rule D.6 no retry and no bypass. A uFurnish mirror also returned 403. No Etsy API, no scrapers, no login, no seller contact.
method.freshness: Snippets are cached snapshots; some are over a year old. Prices, stock and ship-from must be re-checked on the live listing before any decision.

rule_flags: C.4 (2026-09-28) still says 'no handmade and no Etsy'; E.14 (2026-10-12) allows the masterpiece by commission / artisan / Israeli supplier. C.4 is not marked updated, and docs/proposals/style-pools.md also says 'no Etsy, no one-of-a-kind, no made-to-order'. Needs an explicit owner decision on an Etsy/handmade exception for the masterpiece and premium tiers.

A.3 product fidelity: a one-of-a-kind piece sold once no longer matches the render. Prefer repeatable or made-to-order series; one-of-a-kind only as a piece we own (display/stock) or with a 'similar commission' flow.

D.3 / S2B: every lamp needs CE and 220-240V; Israeli lamps also IS 20. No listing stated voltage. US (120V) and Japanese (100V) lamps need rewiring; prefer Israeli and EU makers. Pendants and wired sconces are installed by an electrician (C.6).
D.4: toys and kids products need EN71 / IS 562 shown on the product page. No handmade toy here has a test report (K1 only has EN71 paints).
E.11 / E.13: buying at Etsy retail and reselling leaves no margin. Margin needs a maker trade price, consignment or commission terms; an affiliate link pays ~4%.
G.00 (2026-10-12): new supplier outreach waits for a working site. The maker list is for later; nobody was contacted.

etsy_channel_notes.affiliate: Etsy affiliate runs through Awin; commonly ~4% (2% for user-generated content), 30-day cookie, manual approval, low-traffic sites rejected; Israel eligibility not verified.
etsy_channel_notes.display_or_stock: Buy one piece per style from an Israeli maker, photograph it ourselves, render it faithfully, sell '1 in stock, then made to order' under a written maker agreement.
etsy_channel_notes.commission: Makers with repeatable series (IrisLightingStudio, NoaRazerStudio, MelzerStudio, OsnatFineArt recreations, DzevStudio, YalanzhiObjects, ArtisRaw) suit made-to-order product pages with lead times.
